categories.main_business_segments: On Holding AG operates as a single reportable segment focused on the design, development, and distribution of premium performance sports products. Its primary product categories are footwear (the majority of sales), apparel, and accessories, all engineered for running, outdoor, and all-day activities.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company emphasizes technological innovation, with proprietary technologies such as CloudTec, Helion superfoam, and Speedboard at the core of its footwear. Products are engineered in Switzerland and manufactured by third-party suppliers, primarily in Vietnam for footwear and in China, Vietnam, and Europe for apparel and accessories. On also pursues sustainable materials and circular production models, exemplified by its Cyclon subscription-based recyclable shoe.
categories.primary_customers_markets: On serves a global customer base of athletes, runners, outdoor enthusiasts, and consumers seeking premium, high-performance sportswear. Its key end markets include specialty running stores, sporting goods retailers, fashion/lifestyle outlets, and direct-to-consumer (DTC) customers via e-commerce and owned retail stores.
categories.geographic_coverage: On has a global presence, with products sold in over 60 countries. Its largest markets are North America (56.5% of 2021 sales), Europe (35.9%), and Asia-Pacific (5.9%), with growing operations in China, Japan, and Brazil. The company continues to expand its geographic footprint through both wholesale and DTC channels.
categories.supply_chain_position: On operates downstream in the supply chain as a branded consumer products company. It outsources all manufacturing to third-party suppliers and focuses on product design, innovation, marketing, and distribution through wholesale and DTC channels.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding brand awareness, leveraging innovation to broaden the product portfolio, growing the DTC channel, and entering new geographic markets. R&D focuses on performance technology, sustainability (e.g., recyclable and bio-based materials), and expanding into adjacent categories such as outdoor and tennis. Operational excellence and supply chain resilience are also key themes.
categories.revenue_model: On generates revenue primarily through the sale of physical products—footwear, apparel, and accessories—via wholesale partners and direct-to-consumer channels (e-commerce and owned retail stores). It also experiments with innovative models such as product subscriptions (e.g., Cyclon).
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: On competes in a highly fragmented and competitive market against major global brands such as Nike, adidas, Under Armour, Brooks, Hoka One One, Asics, New Balance, Lululemon, Patagonia, Arcteryx, Anta Group, and Li Ning. The company has established itself among the top 5 running brands in key markets like the US, Germany, and Japan, positioning itself as a premium, innovation-driven alternative.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2021, On reported net sales of CHF 724.6 million, up 70.4% from CHF 425.3 million in 2020, reflecting rapid growth. The company has experienced strong expansion in both wholesale and DTC channels, particularly in North America. Despite net losses due to significant investments and share-based compensation, On demonstrates a high-growth profile with improving gross margins and increasing global scale.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: On differentiates itself through Swiss-engineered performance technology, innovative design, and a strong focus on sustainability. Its products are positioned as premium, offering superior comfort, technical features, and style. The brand emphasizes authenticity, community engagement, and a unique customer experience, supported by grassroots marketing and athlete endorsements.
